glossary.definition: (A) "Contiguous property" includes, but is not limited to, a manufactured home park as defined in section 4781.01 of the Revised Code; a public or publicly subsidized housing project; an apartment complex; a condominium complex; a college or university; an office complex; a shopping center; a hotel; an industrial park; and a race track.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Gas" means natural gas, flammable gas, or gas which is toxic or corrosive.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Gathering line" and the "gathering of gas" have the same meaning as in the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act and the rules adopted by the United States department of transportation pursuant to the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act, including 49 C.F.R. part 192, as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Gas gathering pipeline" means a gathering line that is not regulated under the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act and the rules adopted by the United States department of transportation pursuant to the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act, including 49 C.F.R. part 192, as amended. "Gas gathering pipeline" includes a pipeline used to collect and transport raw natural gas or transmission quality gas to the inlet of a gas processing plant, the inlet of a distribution system, or to a transmission line.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Gas processing plant" means a plant that processes raw natural gas into merchantable products, including transmission quality gas or natural gas liquids and also may include a plant that treats raw natural gas to remove impurities such as carbon dioxide, helium, nitrogen or water.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (F) "Intrastate pipe-line transportation" has the same meaning as in 82 Stat. 720 (1968), 49 U.S.C.A. App. 1671, as amended, but excludes the gathering of gas exempted by the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "MAOP" means the maximum pressure at which a gas gathering pipeline, a processing plant gas stub pipeline, or any segment of such a pipeline may be operated under sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Master-meter system" means a pipe-line system that distributes gas within a contiguous property for which the system operator purchases gas for resale to consumers, including tenants. Such pipe-line system supplies consumers who purchase the gas directly through a meter, or by paying rent, or by other means. The term includes a master-meter system as defined in 49 C.F.R. 191.3, as amended. The term excludes a pipeline within a manufactured home, mobile home, or a building.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act" means the "Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act of 1968," 82 Stat. 720, 49 U.S.C.A. App. 1671 et seq., as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: "Operator" does not include an ultimate consumer who owns a service line, as defined in 49 C.F.R. 192.3, as amended, on the real property of that ultimate consumer.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Operator of a master-meter system" means a person described under division (J)(4)(c) of this section. An operator of a master-meter system is not a public utility under section 4905.02 or a gas or natural gas company under section 4905.03 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Processing plant gas stub pipeline" means a gas pipeline that transports transmission quality gas from the tailgate of a gas processing plant to the inlet of an interstate or intrastate transmission line and that is considered an extension of the gas processing plant, is not for public use, and is not regulated under the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act and the rules adopted by the United States department of transportation pursuant to the Natural Gas Pipeline Safety Act, including 49 C.F.R. part 92, as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (N) "Safety audit" means the public utilities commission's audit of the premises, pipe-line facilities, and the records, maps, and other relevant documents of a master-meter system to determine the operator's compliance with sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code and the pipe-line safety code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (O) "Safety inspection" means any inspection, survey, or testing of a master-meter system which is authorized or required by sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code and the pipe-line safety code. The term includes, but is not limited to, leak surveys, inspection of regulators and critical valves, and monitoring of cathodic protection systems, where applicable.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (P) "Safety-related condition" means any safety-related condition defined in 49 C.F.R. 191.23, as amended.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 4905.90 to 4905.96 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (R) "Transmission quality gas" means gas consisting predominantly of methane that meets all downstream specifications for transportation in an intrastate or interstate transmission pipeline and that is suitable for use by public consumers.

glossary.source_title: Section 4905.90 - Natural gas pipeline safety standards definitions.

glossary.definition: (S) "Raw natural gas" has the same meaning as in section 4906.01 of the Revised Code.
